title: Make the quickstart SDK example executable with the shipped SDK
prompt:
Repair the TypeScript SDK example shown on /docs/quickstart. Evidence: src/app/docs/quickstart/page.tsx:167-184 imports BazaarClient and invokes catalog(), call(), and usage(), then reads total_cost_cents. Local execution against the repository SDK exports confirmed BazaarClient is undefined. The shipped package instead exports Bazaar with catalog.list(), tools.call(), usage.summary(), and total_spend_cents. README.md:63-89 also demonstrates the Bazaar API. A developer copying the current example fails before discovering any tools.

Change only src/app/docs/quickstart/page.tsx in production. Update that SDK snippet to the shipped constructor, method groups, and usage-summary field. Preserve its discover/call/inspect sequence and existing surrounding page content. Keep the example tool clearly illustrative; this task does not add a tool, call production services, or alter registration, balance-loading instructions, billing, or SDK implementation.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/quickstart-sdk-contract.test.ts. Render the actual page through in-memory TypeScript transpilation and JSX stubs, extract the displayed Usage snippet, and execute it against the real repository SDK with a fixture fetch implementation. Assert the catalog, proxy, and summary request paths and the printed total calls and dollar amount for a known total_spend_cents fixture. Ensure the test exercises displayed code rather than an independently rewritten example. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/quickstart-sdk-contract.test.ts. Use existing dependencies and fake fixture values only; no credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, or auth changes. Do not commit or push; work on the assigned branch you are on.
